text:
maria-sales: FYI NexusBank just asked if we can move the joint POC from partner sandbox into their staging tenant next week. They want end-to-end tests (SSO, VPC peering, throughput) before signing a Q3 commit.

tom-partner-eng: Awesome — what are the must-haves from their side?

maria-sales: Legal/security needs an answer on audit log retention and KMS rotation, finance wants a quote for burst capacity and a per-tenant throttle plan, and the infra team wants a clear failover plan.

leo-sre: For throttle: we can expose per-tenant QPS + burst credits. Default = 50 r/s, burst up to 500 for 2 minutes. If they want steady higher throughput we'll need dedicated pool (Reserved capacity).

anya-se: NexusBank's security questionnaire specifically asks about: SOC2 scope for partner-hosted infrastructure, KMS (HSM support, rotation cadence), VPC peering controls, and export controls/data residency. Legal flagged indemnity for cross-border data flows.

tom-partner-eng: Can we give a sample runbook for migration windows? They want zero-downtime cutover and an automatic fallback to hosted API on errors. Also need a checklist for SAML cert rollover.

leo-sre: Draft runbook snippet below (will expand):
```
- Prepare staging tenant + test data snapshot
- Validate SAML SSO in staging (assertion attributes + groups)
- Smoke test: 1000 requests over 10s, verify 95p latency < 250ms
- Enable VPC peering and test egress path
- Cutover in 30m maintenance window; monitor error rates and QPS
- If 5xx > 1% or latency > 500ms for 5m -> rollback to hosted
```

maria-sales: That looks good. Finance: they asked for pricing examples — can we give a short table of options? (bullets ok).

leo-sre: Pricing examples (informal):
- Shared POC (partner sandbox): free for 30 days, egress billed at list rate
- Staging tenant (short-term reserved): $X/day + egress; includes burst credits (2 x baseline)
- Prod reserved capacity: monthly commit, includes SLA & 24/7 support

anya-se: Security answers we can provide today: SOC2 scope includes partner-managed infra if we run the tenancy; we support customer-managed KMS (imported key) + HSM-backed option. Log retention: standard 90 days; extendable to 7 years for an add-on (legal must sign).

maria-sales: Legal will push back on the add-on unless indemnity language is nailed. Tom — can you confirm partner's willingness to accept extended retention?

tom-partner-eng: Partner says they can accept extended retention for enterprise customers if we sign a data processing addendum. They need a list of required claims for their compliance team.

maria-sales: Action items: (1) Leo to send expanded runbook + test scripts, (2) Anya to prepare security Qs answers and sample DPA language, (3) Tom to confirm partner's compliance consent and provide contact for their legal/compliance.

leo-sre: I'll attach a small load test snippet (k6) — quick smoke to run in staging:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://staging.api.redwood-inference.com/generate', JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'test' }), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $POC_TOKEN' } });
  sleep(0.05);
}
```

opsbot: Note: I've scheduled a 45m joint enablement session on Wed 10:30am PT with NexusBank and the partner. Calendar invites sent.

anya-se: OK — I'll draft quick answers for the questionnaire and post by EOD. If we can get partner legal contact, I'll add the DPA template.

maria-sales: Thanks everyone — goal is to hit staging cutover by next Tue. I'll coordinate with NexusBank PM and update here. :thumbsup:
